q: 云九和蓝驰，哪家先跟我们谈的？
reply:
From my memory, 蓝驰 was the first to engage. We started discussions with 蓝驰 around mid-August, and they did the deep dive — 尽调, TS, and closed the seed round at 7200万 valuation. 云九 initially showed interest but asked for DAU above 2000 before proceeding, then later invested in a competitor.

So 蓝驰 came first and closed. 云九 is out of the picture for this round.
